title: German Courses in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: Everything is priced per **Unterrichtseinheit**, a **45-minute teaching unit**. Berlin’s twelve Volkshochschulen price every course between **50 and 250 per cent of a base value that rose from 2.76 to 3.20 euro on 1 August 2026**, so a normal course is **1.60 to 8.00 euro a unit**.

**German courses up to and including B1 are the exception.** Berlin caps them at **130 per cent of the federal integration-course contribution**, currently 2.29 euro, which puts the ceiling at **2.98 euro a unit** and the floor at 80 cents. **The individual 50 per cent reductions do not apply on this rung**, so a student card and a Berlin-Ticket S change nothing.

**Above B1 the rules swap.** The cheap cap stops at the end of B1, the normal 1.60 to 8.00 euro band returns, and **the 50 per cent reduction comes back** for students, apprentices, Berlin-Ticket S holders, people on Buergergeld, Wohngeld, Arbeitslosengeld or Kurzarbeitergeld, and Ehrenamtskarte holders.

**Two routes can cost nothing.** The **Integrationskurs** is 700 units for 1,603 euro, paid per 100-unit module, with exemption possible and **half refunded if you pass within two years**. The **Berufssprachkurs** above B1 runs in 400-unit blocks and is **free unless you are employed on taxable income over 20,000 euro**, when it is 2.56 euro a unit with half back on success. Both need a **Berechtigungsschein**.

**A private school is roughly two to four times the Volkshochschule ceiling.** The cheaper Berlin intensive courses work out near **5.45 euro a unit** (349 euro for 64 units over four weeks). A school selling by the week runs **200 euro for 20 units**, so 10 euro a unit, plus 35 euro registration, 20 euro of materials every four weeks and a summer surcharge.

**Your employer owes you five paid days a year.** Berlin’s Bildungszeitgesetz gives a five-day week **five working days per calendar year** for a recognised course, **combinable into ten days** by agreement, available six months into the job. **Unused days do not carry over** into the next year.

**Two traps.** Volkshochschule German and integration courses are **booked in person** after a placement appointment, with your passport, and the autumn semester fills early. And cancellation is **free only within 14 days of booking**, then 20 per cent or 10 euro, and **from the fifth day before the start there is no cancellation at all**.
